description: This file defines the LengthClass model class for managing length units in the Opencart admin system, including CRUD operations for length classes and their descriptions, with caching and database interactions.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Model class for managing length measurement units and their descriptions in multiple languages, including CRUD operations and retrieval methods.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Creates a new length class record in the database with provided data, including descriptions for multiple languages, and returns the new ID.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class record identified by ID with new data, replacing descriptions.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Deletes a length class record from the database by ID, along with its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteLengthClassesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions tied to a specific language ID.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Retrieves a length class record with its description for the current language based on its ID.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Fetches a list of length class records with optional filters, sorting, and pagination, utilizing caching for optimization.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of length class records for a specific language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a length class in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific length class ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific length class description based on length class ID and language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given length class ID across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all length class descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Gets a length class description matching a specific unit in the current language.
